positions.name: AsyncJobContractGuarantees
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract for remember guarantee about dispatch, safety, and retrieval?
positions.why: All three expressions describe facets of the same just-ratified contract — its dispatch/receipt mechanics (src-1), its non-blocking/no-loss safety properties (src-2), and its branching retrieval pathway (src-3). The register pass reads all three as the same native-technical-maxim signature (mint-1), and affect holds calm-positive throughout, supporting a single coherent read. Conviction shows a gradient worth holding as tension rather than resolving: src-1 and src-3 carry decision-grade settling language ('ratified', 'Key decision') while src-2 is a flat unhedged claim with no explicit ratification marker — the group still reads as one contract-description under this frame, but the settling force is uneven across its parts.
